Florida Man Finds an 8-Foot Gator Stuck in the Jetty Rocks. So He Sat on It.

A bait-shop road trip in Fort Pierce turned into an alligator rescue, a catch pole failure and one very warm seat.

On Nov. 14, two friends from Okeechobee on a bait-shop road trip stopped at the Fort Pierce Inlet State Park jetty and spotted an 8-foot alligator wedged in the rocks. They called the park, a Florida Fish and Wildlife officer came out, and together they pulled the cold, sluggish gator free. When the catch pole couldn't hold it, one of the friends simply sat on it until its mouth was taped. FWC moved the gator to a nearby freshwater canal, and it survived.
